findings.finding: The blanket sentence that kernels remain in both categories is false for N_P: a kernel of a general map of finite C-projectives need not be C-projective. The needed admissible kernels of surjections onto C-projectives do remain projective. The comparison paragraph must also ensure lifted comparison maps intertwine the nil operators, rather than relying on ordinary C-projectivity alone.
